tasks.label: colcon: build
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && if [ -f install/setup.bash ]; then source install/setup.bash; fi && colcon build --symlink-install --base-paths src

tasks.label: ROS DIF: Gazebo
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && if [ -f install/setup.bash ]; then source install/setup.bash; fi && ros2 launch dif_bringup nav.launch.py gui_config:="${workspaceFolder}/src/dif_gazebo/config/gui.config"

tasks.label: ROS DIF: display model
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && if [ -f install/setup.bash ]; then source install/setup.bash; fi && ros2 launch dif_bringup display.launch.py

tasks.label: ROS DIF: joystick teleop
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && if [ -f install/setup.bash ]; then source install/setup.bash; fi && ros2 launch dif_bringup joy.launch.py

tasks.label: ROS DIF: keyboard teleop
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && if [ -f install/setup.bash ]; then source install/setup.bash; fi && ros2 run teleop_twist_keyboard teleop_twist_keyboard
